messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
To compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor, you need a same-scope evidence set that identifies the semiconductor use case, our exact VNA configuration, the competitor’s exact model/configuration, the same DUT/test conditions, and cited performance results; the current passages contain some R&S VNA facts and some competitor mentions, but they do not provide a supported semiconductor VNA comparison claim. [27][37][42][49][52][96]
### Evidence required
- The semiconductor test need must be stated explicitly, such as the Bare Board for SoCs project where the application is PCB test with probing for impedance, insertion loss, and return loss. [37]
- The source must identify our offered VNA solution for that semiconductor use case, such as the Bare Board for SoCs slide listing ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool as the offered solution. [37]
- The source must also identify the competitor product in the same semiconductor use case; the current Bare Board for SoCs evidence names Advantest and Meritech and the R&S offered solution, but does not name a competitor. [37]
- If using the LSmtron case as competitor evidence, the supported claim is only that the slide lists Products: ZNB40, Competitor: Keysight ENA, Strength: total solution including probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool with local partner, and DUT: Board to Board Connector. [32]
- The LSmtron source does not provide LSmtron’s formal legal name, site, department, purchase date, project name, ZNB40 formal model page, order number, frequency range, configuration, or whether the case was purchase, evaluation, PoC, or only a sales success story. [31]
- For our ZNA product side, the cited document is R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer Specifications, PD 5215.4652.22, Version 24.00, April 2026. [4]
- For our ZNB3000 product side, the cited document is R&S®ZNB3000 Vector Network Analyzer Specifications, PD 3647.5184.22, Version 09.00, July 2026. [88]
- For the competitor side, an official or third-party source is needed for exact model, datasheet version, option codes, order numbers, release status, and test conditions, because the current Keysight battle-card description is an R&S battle-card view and says Keysight claims need official or third-party verification. [42][44]
- Current Keysight ENA evidence is insufficient for performance comparison because it does not list a concrete ENA model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth. [49]
- Current Keysight PNA evidence is insufficient for performance comparison because it does not list a concrete PNA model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth. [52]
- A valid comparison needs the same DUT and test setup details, because current semiconductor-related case notes explicitly lack DUT specifications, frequency range, probe model, de-embedding workflow, PCB material, layer count, fixture, and de-embedding conditions. [38][40]
- A valid comparison needs the calibration and measurement conditions, because R&S ZNA product data depends on storage, warm-up, specified environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval, and applicable internal automatic adjustments. [62]
- A valid comparison must preserve whether numbers are warranted specifications, non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, or measured values, because Rohde & Schwarz does not guarantee non-traceable specifications with limits, typical data, nominal values, or measured values. [1]
- A valid comparison must not convert an application case into a product specification, because the AMD case says optimized setup stability up to 67 GHz but does not state whether this was achieved by ZNB3044 alone or with extender, probe, fixture, or de-embedding. [29]
### Current unsupported gaps
- The passages do not provide a direct semiconductor comparison between an R&S VNA solution and a named competitor VNA under the same DUT, frequency range, fixture, calibration, de-embedding method, and performance metrics. [37][38][40][49][52]
- The passages provide one competitor-context case for ZNB40 versus Keysight ENA, but that case is Board to Board Connector at LSmtron and not a fully specified Semiconductor comparison. [31][32]
- The passages provide Semiconductor-adjacent Bare Board for SoCs evidence for ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool, but that evidence does not include a competitor product. [37]

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補齊 [[R&S ZNA]] 主系列，與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 形成關聯：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本來源的 [[R&S ZNA67]] 是 67 GHz base VNA 型號，並可透過 [[mmWave converter support]] 與 accessories 延伸應用。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

R&S ZNA › Measurement speed
- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。
- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。
- Linear frequency sweep 條件 201 points、10 GHz center frequency、200 MHz span：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog normal 時 time per sweep < 3.9 ms；sweep cycle time < 4.9 ms。
- IEC/IEEE VXI11 over 1 Gbit/s LAN：201 measurement points、800 MHz start frequency、1 GHz stop frequency、1 MHz measurement bandwidth 的 measurement and data transfer time 為 14 ms / 13 ms；201 measurement points magnitude 的 data transfer time 為 1.7 ms / 0.9 ms。
- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。

### Short answer
To compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor, you need a same-scope evidence set that identifies the semiconductor use case, our exact VNA configuration, the competitor’s exact model/configuration, the same DUT/test conditions, and cited performance results; the current passages contain some R&S VNA facts and some competitor mentions, but they do not provide a supported semiconductor VNA comparison claim. [27][37][42][49][52][96]
### Evidence required
- The semiconductor test need must be stated explicitly, such as the Bare Board for SoCs project where the application is PCB test with probing for impedance, insertion loss, and return loss. [37]
- The source must identify our offered VNA solution for that semiconductor use case, such as the Bare Board for SoCs slide listing ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool as the offered solution. [37]
- The source must also identify the competitor product in the same semiconductor use case; the current Bare Board for SoCs evidence names Advantest and Meritech and the R&S offered solution, but does not name a competitor. [37]
- If using the LSmtron case as competitor evidence, the supported claim is only that the slide lists Products: ZNB40, Competitor: Keysight ENA, Strength: total solution including probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool with local partner, and DUT: Board to Board Connector. [32]
- The LSmtron source does not provide LSmtron’s formal legal name, site, department, purchase date, project name, ZNB40 formal model page, order number, frequency range, configuration, or whether the case was purchase, evaluation, PoC, or only a sales success story. [31]
- For our ZNA product side, the cited document is R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer Specifications, PD 5215.4652.22, Version 24.00, April 2026. [4]
- For our ZNB3000 product side, the cited document is R&S®ZNB3000 Vector Network Analyzer Specifications, PD 3647.5184.22, Version 09.00, July 2026. [88]
- For the competitor side, an official or third-party source is needed for exact model, datasheet version, option codes, order numbers, release status, and test conditions, because the current Keysight battle-card description is an R&S battle-card view and says Keysight claims need official or third-party verification. [42][44]
- Current Keysight ENA evidence is insufficient for performance comparison because it does not list a concrete ENA model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth. [49]
- Current Keysight PNA evidence is insufficient for performance comparison because it does not list a concrete PNA model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, measurement accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth. [52]
- A valid comparison needs the same DUT and test setup details, because current semiconductor-related case notes explicitly lack DUT specifications, frequency range, probe model, de-embedding workflow, PCB material, layer count, fixture, and de-embedding conditions. [38][40]
- A valid comparison needs the calibration and measurement conditions, because R&S ZNA product data depends on storage, warm-up, specified environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval, and applicable internal automatic adjustments. [62]
- A valid comparison must preserve whether numbers are warranted specifications, non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, or measured values, because Rohde & Schwarz does not guarantee non-traceable specifications with limits, typical data, nominal values, or measured values. [1]
- A valid comparison must not convert an application case into a product specification, because the AMD case says optimized setup stability up to 67 GHz but does not state whether this was achieved by ZNB3044 alone or with extender, probe, fixture, or de-embedding. [29]
### Current unsupported gaps
- The passages do not provide a direct semiconductor comparison between an R&S VNA solution and a named competitor VNA under the same DUT, frequency range, fixture, calibration, de-embedding method, and performance metrics. [37][38][40][49][52]
- The passages provide one competitor-context case for ZNB40 versus Keysight ENA, but that case is Board to Board Connector at LSmtron and not a fully specified Semiconductor comparison. [31][32]
- The passages provide Semiconductor-adjacent Bare Board for SoCs evidence for ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool, but that evidence does not include a competitor product. [37]

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 既有頁面依 May 2026 specifications 記錄 RF path A 最高 67 GHz、RF path B 最高 44 GHz；本來源中的 SMW200A(44GHz) 只支撐 Samsung case 中使用 44GHz 等級 SMW200A 的 sales-case 語境。
